propositions: The undecomposed and dod_uncertifiable axes use ordinal severity labels (low/medium/high) that LLM models apply unreliably for deterministic gate behavior, rendering current grading ineffective at distinguishing actionable defects.
Historical corpus evidence shows ordinal grades on both axes floor to 0.85 with zero semantic distinction (low==high), and the G5 suppressor hedge fires zero times, making the current ladder inert.

Both axes must be converted to closed Literal kind sets (3 kinds each) with explicit pick rules: advisory kinds contribute 0.55 and never floor, gap kinds contribute 1.0 / floor at 0.85, replacing fuzzy boundaries with deterministic defect taxonomy.

The conversion requires a single IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION bump (plan-v4 to plan-v5) batching both axes and related rewrite across impact_plan, prompts, and three scoring paths (_PLAN_SEVERITY_AXES max, _PLAN_HARD_OVERRIDE_AXES floor loop, dod amplifier).
Decision-margin telemetry (priority - block_threshold) must be recorded per finding in the sidecar to track decision closure headroom as a new artifact.

Zero-LLM evidence gate re-scores all 22,667 persisted findings via ordered regex mapping from recorded prose to kind, reporting old-vs-new flips as a bound (advisory pessimistic / floor optimistic) and escalating iff any unjustified lost block occurs.
